name: @veren-test/page-delivery-dryrun
description: Use when verifying the unattended page-delivery loop end to end across apps: a task delivered to a forum or notebook page session is taken, executed with that page's own tools, and closed with machine-checkable evidence (task_complete) or a stable-code failure (task_fail) — no human in the loop. Not a unit suite; it boots the real registries, task center, and both app plugins over in-memory sessions.
